lines.text: So, here's what actually happens when a plumber misses the call. The customer is not going to leave a voicemail. Nobody leaves voicemails anymore. They hang up.
They're going to go hit the next guy on Google, and that job is going to be gone in 90 seconds. You've lost it. You're gone. Go home.
My phone stopped doing that to me the day a secretary stop started picking up everything, and that's all you need.
